items.title: Sound perception and word recognition
items.expectation: Distinguish selected high-value sounds, word boundaries, names, numbers, and learnt chunks in very clear speech.
items.exit_boundary: A limited learnt repertoire is intelligible with effort and collaborative support.

items.title: Consonant contrasts and place or manner clarity
items.expectation: Produce selected high-impact consonant contrasts clearly enough in names, numbers, key nouns, verbs, and chunks.
items.exit_boundary: A limited learnt repertoire is intelligible with effort and collaborative support.

items.title: Vowel contrasts and reduced vowels
items.expectation: Produce selected meaning-changing vowel contrasts in a bounded learnt repertoire with modelling and repair.
items.exit_boundary: A limited learnt repertoire is intelligible with effort and collaborative support.

items.title: Syllable shape, consonant clusters, and word endings
items.expectation: Preserve selected final consonants and simple clusters when they carry essential word identity or meaning.
items.exit_boundary: A limited learnt repertoire is intelligible with effort and collaborative support.

items.title: Audible grammatical endings
items.expectation: Make selected plural, possessive, and simple verb endings audible when omission changes immediate meaning.
items.exit_boundary: A limited learnt repertoire is intelligible with effort and collaborative support.

items.title: Word stress and stress-sensitive recognition
items.expectation: Place recognisable stress in selected names, numbers, nationalities, jobs, and other lesson-critical words.
items.exit_boundary: A limited learnt repertoire is intelligible with effort and collaborative support.

items.title: Sentence prominence and rhythm
items.expectation: Notice and imitate prominence inside short learnt chunks without a natural-rhythm mastery demand.
items.exit_boundary: A limited learnt repertoire is intelligible with effort and collaborative support.

items.title: Connected-speech perception and production
items.expectation: Recognise a small set of frequent linked or reduced forms inside familiar, very clear chunks.
items.exit_boundary: A limited learnt repertoire is intelligible with effort and collaborative support.

items.title: Intonation, interaction, and stance
items.expectation: Use recognisable contours in a few learnt greetings, questions, checks, and polite responses.
items.exit_boundary: A limited learnt repertoire is intelligible with effort and collaborative support.

items.title: Chunking, pausing, monitoring, and pronunciation repair
items.expectation: Deliver short learnt sense groups, pause safely, and repeat or spell a key item when not understood.
items.exit_boundary: A limited learnt repertoire is intelligible with effort and collaborative support.
